rationale.en: CN listed this shop outfit on July 3 (Friday in the June 30 notice). Recent matched shop outfits arrived globally about 3–4 months later. We widen that comparison to October–November because Global order varies.
rationale.ko: 중국은 6월 30일 공지의 금요일인 7월 3일에 이 상점 의상을 출시했습니다. 최근 대응 상점 의상은 약 3~4개월 후 글로벌에 도입됐습니다. 순서가 달라지는 점을 반영해 10~11월로 넓혀 예상합니다.

assumptions.en: Assumes the Global shop continues to mix recent CN outfits into updates. Three recent outfit matches took 97, 100 and 125 days, but Snowborne Stars took 226 days and seasonal exceptions can arrive together. This small, selected sample is not a probability model. No Global release announcement or guaranteed order was found for this item; it may arrive outside the window or not at all. CN prices are not Global prices.

assumptions.en: Assumes Global continues the Duskgem series after the bow. CN bundled announcements do not guarantee a Global bundle or sequence.
